segments.he: ״נָדַר בְּמוֹהִי הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ כִינּוּיִין״. תַּנְיָא, רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: הָאוֹמֵר ״בְּמוֹהִי״ — לֹא אָמַר כְּלוּם, ״בְּמוֹמָתָא דַּאֲמַר מוֹהִי״ — הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ כִּינּוּיִין לַשְּׁבוּעָה.
segments.en: § It is taught in the mishna: If one used the terms shevuta or shekuka, or «took a vow with» the term «mohi, these are substitute terms» for an oath. «It is taught» in a baraita that «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: One who says» that he is taking an oath «by mohi has not said anything.» However, if he says: «By an oath [bemomata] that Mohi said, these are» valid «substitute terms for an oath.»

positions.claim: 'bemohi' alone means nothing; 'bemomata de-amar mohi' is an oath substitute

unresolved.issue: whether RSBG qualifies or disputes the mishna; the gemara does not say
